clips.title: Switzerland BANS Microsoft Completely - Europe Abandons USA, Germany Saves €15M/Year
clips.source_authority_why: chaîne non répertoriée (294 000 abonnés) — titre racoleur — ajoutée faute de source forte sur ce sujet
clips.quote: Switzerland's Federal Administration, I'm quoting here, aims to reduce its dependency on Microsoft step by step and in the long term, a Federal Chancellery spokesman told NZZ am Sonntag. This comes as a surprise, as Microsoft 365 was recently installed on some 54,000 administration workstations despite concerns about data security.
clips.speaker: El
